name: wxlike-ui
description: wxlike desktop frontend (WP-11): TypeScript + jotai, bundled by esbuild into dist/ — the OLD UI; `npm run build` here now feeds the old-UI escape hatch (src-tauri/tauri.conf.old-ui.json), while the default Tauri host loads apps/desktop-web (issue #158)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/app.js --minify && node scripts/copy-dist-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:wire && npm run check:msgindex
